items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I love Bix... a lot of modern trumpeters listen to him and they don’t see what the big deal is. And I guess because they’ve heard so many Bix imitators now that they don’t realize that he was the source. It starts with him.

ctx.x: I love Bix. And I guess I would take, oh what’s the one with Bix and his gang. Oh come on Vinny I know it. It’s not “Thou Swell” but it’s one of the Bix and his gang ones. I can’t think of the name now. But I got flak for liking Bix actually.
